event: UFC Fight Night 292 - Moicano vs. Nolan

tom-nolan-renato-carneiro.summary: Moicano took Nolan down inside the first two minutes, took his back with a body triangle and rode him for the rest of round 1, hunting the choke. In round 2 he did it again after Nolan stung him with a head kick, until Miragliotta stood them up from back control, a reset the commentary team, the outlets and other fighters called wrong. Back on the feet Nolan dropped him with a knee and battered him to the horn; in round 3 he hurt him again with knees and punches, reversed Moicano's takedown and finished him with punches and elbows at 1:28.
tom-nolan-renato-carneiro.turning_point: Round 2: Miragliotta's stand-up out of Moicano's back control, followed at once by Nolan's knee that dropped him.

checks.claim: Moicano takes the back once the pace drops and finishes it: submission, R2
checks.note: He took the back with a body triangle in rounds 1 and 2, as expected, but never came close to the finish, and lost the position to the referee's stand-up.

jacobe-smith-randy-brown.summary: Brown kept Smith at the end of his jab for most of round 1 until Smith blasted through for a takedown late in the round. Smith took him down again in rounds 2 and 3, got through Brown's armbar attempts and opened a deep cut with elbows in round 2; Brown spent round 3 surviving on his back. Smith won 30-26 on all three cards, the first decision of his unbeaten career.
jacobe-smith-randy-brown.turning_point: Smith's elbows in round 2, which opened Brown up and took the fight out of him.

checks.claim: Smith's wrestling and ground strikes are what beat Brown: KO/TKO, R2
checks.note: Takedowns in every round and the cut came in round 2, as picked, but Brown's guard saw him to the final bell.

cody-durden-ode-osbourne.summary: Durden ate an early shot, took Osbourne down, escaped a guillotine and spent round 1 on his back with a body triangle, then in mount with heavy punches. He took him down three more times in round 2. A tired Durden lost round 3 when Osbourne reversed him and rode his back without threatening: 29-28 on all three cards and on all three of Sherdog's.

luana-santos-yana-santos.summary: Yana stuffed Luana's trips and throws and held her on the fence for most of round 1, adding knees and a right hand, and won it on every Sherdog card. From round 2 Luana got her takedowns: a double leg, the back, mount, and in round 3 a takedown straight to the back with both hooks, riding out most of the round. Luana won 29-28 on all three cards, a fight the outlets agreed was more control than damage.
luana-santos-yana-santos.turning_point: Round 2: Luana's first clean takedown and back take; Yana could not keep her off after that.

jean-paul-lebosnoyani-farman-hasanov.summary: Hasanov took Lebosnoyani down early in each of the first two rounds, but he stood up at once every time and out-landed him at range with low kicks, body kicks and the jab. Hasanov was wilting by the end of round 2, badly hurt and opened up over the left eye (one Sherdog scorer had it 10-8); early in round 3 the cut ran the length of his eyebrow and the doctor stopped it at 2:11.
jean-paul-lebosnoyani-farman-hasanov.turning_point: The body kick midway through round 2 that doubled Hasanov over; from then he was backing up.

checks.claim: Override: Hasanov fades from R2 and does little damage; Lebosnoyani wins the late rounds: decision
checks.note: Hasanov was spent from midway through round 2; the stoppage came on a cut, not on the cards.

dakota-hope-francis-marshall.summary: Marshall, two pounds over the featherweight limit, chopped Hope's lead leg with calf kicks in round 1, swept him once and added a takedown. Hope came back in round 2 behind pressure, and in round 3 he staggered Marshall with an overhand right, sprawled on his desperation shot, took the back and kept hitting him to the bell. Hope won a split decision (29-28, 28-29, 29-28), as Sherdog's three scorers had it; MMA Junkie had Marshall.
dakota-hope-francis-marshall.turning_point: Round 3: Hope's overhand right, and his sprawl and back take on Marshall's takedown attempt.

checks.claim: Hope is a front-loaded striker who faded in his debut; Marshall's top control grows as he tires: decision
checks.note: Hope was the stronger man in rounds 2 and 3 and won the last one clearly.

rodrigo-sezinando-theodor-berggren.summary: A grappling-heavy first round was close until Sezinando, whose takedowns kept being reversed or stuffed, dropped Berggren at the horn with a spinning backfist and a left hook. In round 2 he got his takedowns, took the back, then mount, and landed punches and elbows to the bell; the cageside doctor stopped it before round 3 because of a severe cut on Berggren's lip (TKO, 5:00 of round 2).
rodrigo-sezinando-theodor-berggren.turning_point: The spinning backfist at the end of round 1.

julian-erosa-jeong-yeong-lee.summary: Lee hit Erosa straight off the glove touch and floored him with a left hook, then jumped on a guillotine that nearly ended it in the opening seconds. Erosa got free, clinched, and as Lee kept swinging wildly, dropped him with an overhand right and finished him with punches at 1:31 of round 1, in what he had said would be his last fight. It earned him a $100,000 bonus.
julian-erosa-jeong-yeong-lee.turning_point: Erosa's overhand right in the middle of a wild exchange, a minute after he had been dropped.

zachary-reese-mickey-gall.summary: Reese out-struck Gall in all three rounds with body kicks, knees and combinations, but was docked a point for an eye poke in round 1, which left that round 9-9 on Sherdog's cards. Gall, back after almost two years, was more competitive than expected with overhand rights and left hooks against Reese's open chin, though the body kicks hurt him in round 3. Reese won 29-27 on all three cards.

joseph-kropschot-nick-klein.summary: Klein was the busier striker early and took Kropschot down in round 1, but Kropschot, in his UFC debut, stood, attacked a choke from the front headlock, and ended the round on Klein's back with a body triangle and a rear-naked choke attempt. Klein took him down again early in round 2 and even reached the back; Kropschot turned into him and finished with an inverted triangle and armbar at 1:25.
joseph-kropschot-nick-klein.turning_point: Kropschot's reversal off Klein's round-2 takedown, straight into the inverted triangle.

piera-rodriguez-talita-alencar.summary: Alencar won rounds 1 and 2 on Sherdog's cards with her grappling: a trip and a long spell on Rodriguez's back in round 1 (fought through a partial power cut in the arena), and a takedown, elbows from half guard and an armbar attempt late in round 2. Rodriguez out-struck her on the feet throughout, most clearly in round 3, and all three judges gave her every round, 30-27; Sherdog's three scorers all had Alencar 29-28.

Szabova took round 2 from top and back with ground strikes, and in round 3 she passed to mount, took the back and punched until Tognoni stopped it at 3:20.
